name: BITEZ - Triple-Stacked 2,000MG Gummies - Rainbow Sherbet - Limited Edition
description:
Get ready for the ultimate limited-edition drop: Rainbow Sherbet TRIPLE-Stacked gummies, the most layered edibles you've ever experienced. Each exclusive 2-count bag delivers 1,000mg per gummy with a potent blend of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP. Three vibrant flavor layers bring tangy raspberry, zesty orange, and fresh lime together in one nostalgic rainbow sherbet experience. This release won't be around long so stock up now before they're gone!

Details

• Rainbow Sherbet (3 Layers- Raspberry, Orange, Lime)

• 2,000 mg per bag

• 1,000mg per gummy

Cannabinoids

• THCP

• Delta-9

• Delta-8

What is THCP?

THCP unforgettable high

Experience an unforgettable high with THCP, the most potent THC cannabinoid. THCP offers immediate and highly psychoactive effects that are approximately 33x as strong as Delta-9.

What is Delta-9?

Delta-9 has more psychoactive effects than Delta-8

Discover the most abundant THC compound found in cannabis that offers slightly more psychoactive effects than Delta-8! This amazing compound metabolizes in the liver and other organs some time after consumption, providing an incredible euphoric relaxation experience that's sure to leave you feeling blissful and serene.

What is Delta-8?

Delta-8 is made from pure CBD

Delta-8, the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. Delta-8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

How should I dose these Bitez?

Start low, go slow.

Bitez gummies are high-potency heavyweights engineered for maximum 1,000mg impact. If you aren’t a seasoned pro, we strongly recommend starting with 1/4 of a gummy and waiting at least 90 minutes to gauge the effects. Respect the potency and find your perfect vibe.
